description: Rubbermaid Pantry Organization Under Shelf Pull Out Small Drawer. Designed for wire and wood shelving, the Rubbermaid Small Drawer mounts under shelves and slides out and down so you can easily access stored items like spices, packets or even linens. It can hold two standard sized packages of wraps such as aluminum or plastic wraps.
